text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Seeking the Pearl and I are<n>on our way
back from an outing when<n>we hear a lively voice
calling out to<n>us.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
Hey, miss! How about a little miso<n>soup to go with
your dinner tonight?<n>This miso paste here blew the
socks<n>off of a hundred elite chefs!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It has such a rich aroma! There's no<n>way it
doesn't taste fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But... I'm sorry! I would love to buy<n>some, but I'll
have to give it a pass<n>today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl usually jumps at<n>the chance to
explore new<n>possibilities for miso soup, so I'm
puzzled by her response.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's something else I want. Could<n>you tag
along with me for a little<n>shopping?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay, so first we need some daikon<n>radish and
cabbage... maybe a little<n>fried tofu too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For the broth, let's go with some<n>bonito flakes and
kelp! Oh, and we<n>can't forget the star of the
show—miso paste!
choice_data_list:
Wait, but didn't you just pass up buying miso
paste from that vendor?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That wasn't the miso paste I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The miso paste Seeking the Pearl<n>picks isn't
anything luxurious or<n>fancy, but rather just some
ordinary<n>variety for household use.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Okay, that's everything.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting, Trainer. Well then,<n>go ahead and
dig in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl watches me with a<n>serious look
on her face. This<n>particular miso soup seems to
hold<n>some special significance to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the flavor isn't anything<n>remarkable. It
tastes just like the<n>everyday miso soup you'd eat
at<n>home. It's almost bizarre how, well,<n>normal it is.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. You look confused.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I get it now! The answer is to pair<n>them like cheese
and crackers<n>instead of forcing them together like
chocolate milk!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined that taking a step<n>back could
broaden my horizons and<n>reveal so many
possibilities! It's all<n>thanks to you for stopping me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Today's miso soup is a statement<n>from me to you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And that intent is that I want to etch<n>out a future
with you that's just like<n>this miso soup.
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This plain miso soup is just like the<n>future. It's a
blank canvas, full of<n>possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Do we want to improve its taste, or<n>increase its
nutritional value? There<n>are so many countless
things we<n>could do to it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
How should we prepare it? What<n>ingredients
should we use? Because<n>nothing about it has been
decided, we<n>can do whatever welike!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The future's the same! Numerous<n>choices are right
there before our<n>eyes, ripe for the picking!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That the kind of future I want to forge<n>together with
you—one overflowing<n>with possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
With you by my side, I can<n>accomplish feats that
will turn the<n>world upside down!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
With you by my side, I can carve my<n>name into
racing history and create a<n>legend that will be talked
about until<n>the end of time!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can accomplish anything if<n>I'm with
you—the person who helped<n>me realize the
possibilities inherent<n>within miso soup!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Together, we can do anything!
Yeah! Together, we can do anything!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Trainer, what kind of future<n>do you
envisage us having?
choice_data_list: A future where we keep tackling new challenges!
One where we can keep laughing forever.

The only thing I'm sure of is that you'll be there
beside me.

The only thing I'm sure of is that you'll be there
beside me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Trainer, what kind of future<n>do you
envisage us having?
choice_data_list: A future where we keep tackling new challenges!
One where we can keep laughing forever.

The only thing I'm sure of is that you'll be there
beside me.

The only thing I'm sure of is that you'll be there
beside me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, right. We don't need a finish<n>line.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even after we've achieved our goals<n>and dreams,
there will still be endless<n>possibilities ahead!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We can't just sit around and watch<n>them pass us
by!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No matter the distance, let's keep<n>pushing forward!
You and I—together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A future full of challenges won't be<n>an easy ride.
But as long as we're<n>together, I know that we'll
find a path<n>forward!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! What a splendid and lively<n>future!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Laughter can fill you with energy and<n>has the
power to draw out new<n>possibilities from you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay then, let's keep laughing<n>together! Let's fill
the world with the<n>echoes of our laughter and seize
every possibility with our two hands!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us let our laughter ring out.<n>The day
when our voices sweep<n>across the world will
surely come!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Gorgeously said! I feel the same!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't we try to imagine<n>what might await
the two of us?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For instance... Imagine I manage to<n>win first in a
never-before-done<n>international race between 100
runners!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It would truly be a monumental<n>achievement for the
two of us! You<n>could even say it'd mark the
beginning of a new historical era!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The possible futures we discuss<n>become more and
more colorful as<n>our ideas keep flowing out. We
continue to talk until the sun goes<n>down.
